Preserve exact rounded black oval eyes, rounded nose, rosy cheeks, chunky sculpted hair, youthful sturdy proportions, matte tactile clay surface of that character. Warm soft daylight, friendly expressive face, entire head hair hands and shoes visible, centered with generous clear margin, portrait composition. Slight three-quarter turn toward viewer. No ball.
